answer: Make onboarding quorum-sponsored with recursive liability. Each newcomer needs k distinct established sponsors who each lock a reputation crystal; if that identity is later proven fake, every sponsor is slashed and the loss echoes transitively up the vine of whoever sponsored those sponsors. So vouching for a sybil never costs just one bond; it propagates up the lineage that admitted it, forcing a fake fleet to pay in cascading burned reputation across its whole sponsorship tree, not a one-time fee.
